headline: Farranac Front Rekindles as Heavy Fighting Spreads
war_summary: Since the last edition, FarranacCoastHex has become the freshest active line, rising to twelve base events in twenty-four hours, with two in the latest two-hour window; ten of eleven holdings remain Colonial and one is neutral. LinnMercyHex has recorded six events in six hours and eleven across the day, while its Colonial majority remains ten bases to one. WeatheredExpanseHex continues to lead the contested sectors with twenty-two daily events and five in six hours, its ledger still divided five Warden to four Colonial, amid sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments. StonecradleHex retains its nine-base split—six Colonial, three Warden—and twelve daily events, though the latest six hours show no recorded turnover; fighting and enlistment rates are nevertheless accelerating. MooringCountyHex has seen the heaviest fresh pressure outside those belts, with more than a thousand casualties for each faction in two hours and two daily base events, including a Colonial capture in a sector otherwise held by the Wardens. FishermansRowHex remains active at sixteen daily events, but none have appeared in the latest two hours and all nine bases are Colonial.
